title: 9" disposable chopsticks
text: 9" disposable chopsticks. VERY nice disposable chopsticks.  Bamboo, not that soft balsam wood. They are smooth and pointy at one end, and sort of oval shaped at the top... Each is individually wrapped.  In my opinion, they are well worth the price. Of course, I always update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Royal Premium Disposable Bamboo Chopsticks in Sleeves, 9 Inch, Connected at the Top, UV Treated, Bag of 100
features: TWIN STYLE: These chopsticks are connected at the top. They are easily separated by hand to allow for an easy, comfortable dining experience.

HIGH-QUALITY and CONVENIENT! As a one time use product, this product helps to reduce the time it takes to clean up after meals. Using disposable cutlery or utensils can be more sanitary than using reusable items.

MADE FROM high-quality bamboo, which is a readily and rapidly renewable resource. The rapid regrowth of bamboo makes bamboo products an ideal alternative to wooden products. They are completely biodegradable and can be thrown out with other compostable items. Bamboo chopsticks also offer more tensile strength than wooden chopsticks.

PERFECT FOR EVENTS, AT HOME, OR WITH TAKE-OUT ORDERS! Chopsticks can help bring more authenticity to your dining experience. They are an excellent product for use with take-out orders, dinner parties and every day dining. They are perfect for many Chinese, Japanese, Vietnamese, and Korean dishes and take-out orders. A must have in any kitchen!

SAFE and DURABLE! We are serious about safety- these chopsticks have been UV treated and offer a splinter-free dining experience. The smooth surface offers a pleasant and comfortable dining experience, without the risk of getting splinters in your mouth.
description: Sanitary and safe: each pair of chopsticks comes in their own sleeve, which makes them perfect for storing in your kitchen. They have been UV treated. Eco-friendly and convenient! These chopsticks are made from high quality, all natural bamboo. Bamboo is a very readily renewable resource, and is replenished at a much faster rate than other building materials. Completely biodegradable, these chopsticks can be disposed of with food waste. They are a perfect balance between eco-friendly and convenient. Perfect for dinner parties, take-out orders, and more! These chopsticks are attached at the top. Each sleeve contains one pair of chopsticks. They are smooth and do not splinter. They are an excellent addition to any table setting, helping you serve up authenticity at any meal.
